title: Mexican Potato Salad
description: A twist on traditional potato salad, this Mexican version adds a crunchy touch with fresh floral garnish.

ingredients.name: crunchy salad
ingredients.notes: mixed greens with a hint of crunch

ingredients.name: floral garnish
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs such as cilantro, scallions, or chives

instructions: Toss diced potatoes with a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Bake potatoes for 15-20 minutes or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine baked potatoes, mixed greens, and a squeeze of lime juice.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic powder (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Pour dressing over potato mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs and serve.
